final: WITH patient_avg AS (SELECT e.ID, p.SEX, AVG(e."aCL IgM") AS acl_igm FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY e.ID, p.SEX), deviations AS (SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, acl_igm - AVG(acl_igm) OVER () AS deviation FROM patient_avg), sex_averages AS (SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm, deviation, AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY SEX) AS sex_avg_deviation FROM deviations) SELECT ID, SEX, acl_igm AS "aCL IgM", deviation, deviation - sex_avg_deviation AS excess FROM sex_averages WHERE deviation > sex_avg_deviation ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
